affected_subject.reason: Identifies the CLOB order-posting zero-cost check at CLOB.sol L503-L505.

trigger_or_action.reason: Posting non-post-only orders whose received/sent amounts trigger the bitwise '&' check.

direct_effect.reason: Valid orders revert due to incorrect '&' zero-check, causing denial of service.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected behavior is that only true zero-cost trades are rejected; actual check rejects valid nonzero amounts, giving expected-vs-actual relation.

summary: Fragments identify the CLOB zero-cost check, the '&' operator misuse, the triggering order posting, and the resulting revert of valid orders, sufficient to attempt formalization.
